Texts.quest.intro_fishinghut: A Catch for the Beast Pen
Texts.hero.warrior_bran.description: Holds the line and leads a march faster than anyone.
Texts.hero.warrior_bran.lore: Bran was a smith in a border village until an army marched past it and never stopped. Since that day he has carried a shield forged from the door of his own smithy, and he has never once retreated. Not out of stubbornness, he says, but because he has tried retreating before.
Texts.skill.warrior_bran_smash.description: A heavy blow that lowers the target's defense.
Texts.skill.warrior_bran_guard.description: Shields himself and taunts the enemy.
Texts.skill.warrior_bran_swift_march.descripti: Speeds up a march led by this hero.
Texts.hero.archer_lyra.description: Strikes first and leads the army by the shortest road.
Texts.hero.archer_lyra.lore: Lyra grew up in a watchtower where the only pastime was counting the steps of strangers on the horizon. She learned to hit what others cannot yet see. She shoots in silence and never looks to check whether she hit.
Texts.skill.archer_lyra_venom.description: A shot that leaves poison behind.
Texts.skill.archer_lyra_aimed.description: A shot past the front line into the rear.
Texts.skill.archer_lyra_swift_march.descriptio: Speeds up a march led by this hero.
Texts.skill.archer_lyra_tempering_1.descriptio: Lyra teaches the army not to stand under the blow. Defense for all squads.
Texts.hero.knight_ordwin.description: Pierces armor: empowers spearmen and lowers the target's defense in dungeons.
Texts.hero.knight_ordwin.lore: Ordwin swore fealty to three lords, and all three lost. He refused to serve a fourth, took his horse and his spear, and rode east. Now his spear is worth more than the title he was once promised.
Texts.skill.knight_ordwin_lance.description: A strike that reaches the rear as well.
Texts.skill.knight_ordwin_tempering_1.descript: Ordwin keeps the line from breaking. Defense for all squads.
Texts.hero.mage_iselle.description: Multiplies damage against crowds. Strongest against a tight formation.
Texts.hero.mage_iselle.lore: Of the academy's nine flames, Iselle was left to tend the smallest, the one a draft could snuff out. She fanned it until the academy burned down, along with the other eight flames. No one put her on trial: there was no one left who could.
Texts.skill.mage_iselle_storm.description: A magic strike on all enemies that stuns them.
Texts.skill.mage_iselle_tempering_1.descriptio: A wall of fire between the army and the enemy. Defense for all squads.
Texts.skill.mage_iselle_tempering_2.descriptio: A flame no one can pass through. Strong defense for all squads.
Texts.hero.warrior_hedda.description: Holds the line where others fall back.
Texts.hero.warrior_hedda.lore: Raised in a border outpost; she got her first shield before her first bread.
Texts.skill.warrior_hedda_smash.description: A heavy blow that lowers the target's defense.
Texts.skill.warrior_hedda_guard.description: Shields herself and taunts the enemy.
Texts.skill.warrior_hedda_tempering_1.descript: Hedda closes the ranks. Defense for all squads.
Texts.hero.warrior_torvald.description: A veteran of a hundred sieges, still alive to everyone's surprise.
Texts.hero.warrior_torvald.lore: They say he never lost a single defense, because he never gave up a wall.
Texts.skill.warrior_torvald_smash.description: A heavy blow that lowers the target's defense.
Texts.skill.warrior_torvald_guard.description: Shields himself and taunts the enemy.
Texts.skill.warrior_torvald_fervor_2.descripti: Torvald knows where a wall will crack. Attack for all squads.
Texts.hero.warrior_maren.description: Strikes first and asks no names.
Texts.hero.warrior_maren.lore: Her axe is older than she is, an heirloom from her mother, an axebearer too.
Texts.skill.warrior_maren_smash.description: A heavy blow that lowers the target's defense.
Texts.skill.warrior_maren_guard.description: Shields herself and taunts the enemy.
Texts.skill.warrior_maren_tempering_0.descript: Maren's infantry goes into battle in mail. Infantry defense.
Texts.skill.warrior_maren_tempering_1.descript: Whoever has stood beside Maren no longer fears a blow. Defense for all squads.
Texts.hero.knight_aldric.description: Leads spearmen in a wedge that knows no stopping.
Texts.hero.knight_aldric.lore: A knight without a castle: all he owns is a horse, a spear, and his word.
Texts.skill.knight_aldric_lance.description: A strike that reaches the rear as well.
Texts.skill.knight_aldric_tempering_1.descript: Aldric's wedge does not break on shields. Defense for all squads.
Texts.hero.knight_serah.description: Guards the flanks as if they were her home.
Texts.hero.knight_serah.lore: She served in the mounted guard of three lords and betrayed none of them.
Texts.skill.knight_serah_lance.description: A strike that reaches the rear as well.
Texts.skill.knight_serah_fervor_2.description: Serah strikes where she expected the blow to come from. Attack for all squads.
Texts.hero.archer_finn.description: Shoots where others have not looked yet.
Texts.hero.archer_finn.lore: A hunter from the northern woods; he saw a city for the first time at twenty.
Texts.skill.archer_finn_venom.description: A shot that leaves poison behind.
Texts.skill.archer_finn_aimed.description: A shot past the front line into the rear.
Texts.skill.archer_finn_tempering_0.descriptio: Finn's bowmen shoot from cover. Archer defense.
Texts.skill.archer_finn_tempering_1.descriptio: No enemy sneaks up unseen. Defense for all squads.
Texts.hero.archer_ysolde.description: No one hears her bowstring, and no one sees her arrows.
Texts.hero.archer_ysolde.lore: An apprentice of the forest scouts; she speaks little and always hits.
Texts.skill.archer_ysolde_venom.description: A shot that leaves poison behind.
Texts.skill.archer_ysolde_aimed.description: A shot past the front line into the rear.
Texts.skill.archer_ysolde_tempering_1.descript: Ysolde's army is hard to track. Defense for all squads.
Texts.hero.archer_rook.description: A mercenary with a bow, and a conscience for an extra fee.
Texts.hero.archer_rook.lore: He has served under five banners, but never once switched sides mid-battle.
Texts.skill.archer_rook_venom.description: A shot that leaves poison behind.
Texts.skill.archer_rook_aimed.description: A shot past the front line into the rear.
Texts.skill.archer_rook_tempering_0.descriptio: Rook never skimps on armor for his own. Archer defense.
Texts.skill.archer_rook_tempering_1.descriptio: Rook's mercenaries know what a life is worth. Defense for all squads.
Texts.hero.mage_calder.description: Calls down a storm wherever the enemy stands.
Texts.hero.mage_calder.lore: Expelled from the academy for experiments that were too loud, and too successful.
Texts.skill.mage_calder_bolt.description: A magic strike past the front line.
Texts.skill.mage_calder_tempering_0.descriptio: Calder's spears catch lightning. Spearmen defense.
Texts.skill.mage_calder_tempering_1.descriptio: A storm over the army drives the enemy back. Defense for all squads.
Texts.hero.mage_nerys.description: Turns aside blows before they are even struck.
Texts.hero.mage_nerys.lore: Her shields are made of light and calculation; not one has ever cracked.
Texts.skill.mage_nerys_bolt.description: A magic strike past the front line.
Texts.skill.mage_nerys_fervor_2.description: Nerys turns the enemy's own strength against them. Attack for all squads.
Texts.hero.warrior_gunnar.description: A wall that goes on the attack.
Texts.hero.warrior_gunnar.lore: They say he has no heart, only a stone that beats slowly and forever.
Texts.skill.warrior_gunnar_quake.description: A strike on all enemies that lowers their defense.
Texts.skill.warrior_gunnar_guard.description: Shields himself and taunts the enemy.
Texts.hero.knight_elowen.description: The first ray of light and the first strike are always hers.
Texts.hero.knight_elowen.lore: Born at the dawn of the battle that decided the fate of three kingdoms.
Texts.skill.knight_elowen_banner.description: A strike and a battle cry for the whole team.
Texts.skill.knight_elowen_tempering_1.descript: Dawn finds her army ready. Defense for all squads.
Texts.skill.knight_elowen_tempering_2.descript: Under her standard, night never falls. Strong defense for all squads.
Texts.hero.archer_kestrel.description: No target is too far, and none is too fast.
Texts.hero.archer_kestrel.lore: Her falcon sees farther than she can shoot, and that is the only thing that annoys her.
Texts.skill.archer_kestrel_aimed.description: A shot past the front line into the rear.
Texts.skill.archer_kestrel_tempering_0.descrip: Kestrel's archers shoot from on high. Archer defense.
Texts.skill.archer_kestrel_tempering_1.descrip: Whoever sees first never falls into a trap. Defense for all squads.
Texts.skill.archer_kestrel_tempering_2.descrip: No ambush can hide from her eyes. Strong defense for all squads.
Texts.hero.mage_vael.description: Stays silent while his enemies still breathe.
Texts.hero.mage_vael.lore: A vow of silence is the price of the power he took from a dead academy.
Texts.skill.mage_vael_storm.description: A magic strike on all enemies that stuns them.
Texts.skill.mage_vael_tempering_1.description: Vael's silence muffles the enemy's blow. Defense for all squads.
Texts.skill.mage_vael_tempering_2.description: Near him, even steel strikes softer. Strong defense for all squads.
Texts.hero.mage_sabine.lore: Her winter arrives in July and leaves whenever it pleases.
Texts.skill.mage_sabine_storm.description: A magic strike on all enemies that stuns them.
Texts.item.hero_essence_t2.description: Raises a hero from tier one to tier two. Requires world level 2
Texts.item.hero_essence_t3.description: Raises a hero from tier two to tier three. Requires world level 3
Texts.item.crate_gold_5000.description: 5,000 gold guaranteed, plus a random 5,000 to 1,000,000 more
Texts.item.crate_mixed_large.description: A bundle of resources for building up
Texts.item.scout_veil_24h.description: Hides your village from scouting for 24 hours
Texts.item.teleport.description: Moves your settlement to a free tile of your choice
Texts.item.teleport_nearby.description: Moves your settlement to a free tile of your choice no more than 100 tiles from where it stands now
Texts.item.teleport_clan.description: Moves your settlement to a free tile of your choice within your clan's territory
Texts.item.teleport_random.description: Moves your settlement to a random free tile in the open part of the world
Texts.item.teleport_leader.description: Moves your settlement to the nearest free tile next to your clan leader's village
Texts.item.beast_feed.description: Treat a tamed beast in the Beast Pen: it gains a level and its passive grows stronger
Texts.item.universal_shard_common.description: Turns into a shard of any hero of this rarity you have already unlocked, for raising stars
Texts.item.universal_shard_rare.description: Turns into a shard of any hero of this rarity you have already unlocked, for raising stars
Texts.item.universal_shard_unique.description: Turns into a shard of any hero of this rarity you have already unlocked, for raising stars
Texts.item.hero_xp_small.description: Adds 500 XP to the shared hero pool, to spend on leveling any hero
Texts.item.hero_xp_medium.description: Adds 5,000 XP to the shared hero pool, to spend on leveling any hero
Texts.item.hero_xp_large.description: Adds 50,000 XP to the shared hero pool, to spend on leveling any hero
Texts.item.hero_xp_1k.description: Adds 1,000 XP to the shared hero pool, to spend on leveling any hero
Texts.item.hero_xp_10k.description: Adds 10,000 XP to the shared hero pool, to spend on leveling any hero
Texts.item.hero_xp_20k.description: Adds 20,000 XP to the shared hero pool, to spend on leveling any hero
Texts.item.weapon_chest.description: A piece of a unique weapon for a first-world banner hero of your choice: Gunnar, Elowen, or Kestrel. Opened from the hero card
Texts.item.weapon_chest_2.description: A piece of a unique weapon for a second-world banner hero of your choice: Sabine, Vael, or Iselle. Opened from the hero card
Texts.item.wrench_common.description: Gives an artifact 100 level XP, the same as feeding it a common artifact
Texts.item.wrench_rare.description: Gives an artifact 300 level XP, the same as feeding it a rare artifact
Texts.item.dungeon_energy_10.description: Adds 10 dungeon energy, enough for one run. Works even past a full bar
Texts.item.dungeon_energy_50.description: Adds 50 dungeon energy, enough for five runs. Works even past a full bar
Texts.item.repair_kit.description: Repairs an artifact broken by a failed enhancement, at any enhancement level and without gems
Texts.item.whetstone.description: Pay the smith with these for an attempt to enhance an artifact at the Forge: +1 costs 10 stones, +10 costs 50, +20 costs 100. A failed attempt still takes the stones
Texts.item.chest_supply.description: Hero XP, resources, speed-ups, and wrenches: everything the convoy carries
Texts.item.chest_treasure.description: Artifacts, hero shards, and repair kits; a unique artifact by the 20th chest at the latest
Texts.item.chest_traveler.description: One teleport; a full Teleport by the 4th chest at the latest
Texts.item.chest_boosts.description: Production, attack, and defense boosts, plus a scout veil, by the 5th chest at the latest
Texts.item.chest_books_common.description: Skill books for common heroes: warrior, knight, and archer, attack and defense
Texts.item.chest_books_rare.description: Skill books for rare heroes: warrior, knight, and archer, attack and defense
Texts.item.chest_books_unique.description: Skill books for unique heroes: warrior, knight, and archer, attack and defense
Texts.item.speedup_1m.description: Cuts 1 min off any timer: construction, training, troop upgrades, or marches
Texts.item.speedup_5m.description: Cuts 5 min off any timer: construction, training, troop upgrades, or marches
Texts.item.speedup_10m.description: Cuts 10 min off any timer: construction, training, troop upgrades, or marches
Texts.item.speedup_1h.description: Cuts 1 h off any timer: construction, training, troop upgrades, or marches
Texts.item.speedup_5h.description: Cuts 5 h off any timer: construction, training, troop upgrades, or marches
Texts.item.speedup_8h.description: Cuts 8 h off any timer: construction, training, troop upgrades, or marches
Texts.item.speedup_12h.description: Cuts 12 h off any timer: construction, training, troop upgrades, or marches

Texts.item.skill_book_warrior_common_defense.d: Raises the defense skill of a common warrior: levels cost 3, 5, 7, 10, and 12 books. Each further level is unlocked by one more hero star.

Texts.item.skill_book_knight_rare_defense.desc: Raises the defense skill of a rare knight: levels cost 3, 5, 7, 10, and 12 books. Each further level is unlocked by one more hero star.

Texts.item.skill_book_archer_common_defense.de: Raises the defense skill of a common archer: levels cost 3, 5, 7, 10, and 12 books. Each further level is unlocked by one more hero star.

Texts.item.chest_key_rare.description: Four rewards: speed-ups, hero XP, items, shards, and sometimes a whole hero
Texts.item.chest_key_unique.description: Four rewards, including unique hero shards, universal shards, and whetstones
Texts.item.key_rare.description: Opens a Rare Chest beyond the free openings
Texts.item.key_unique.description: Opens a Unique Chest beyond the free opening
Texts.artifactSet.flint.description: Stone for the first axes. Holds infantry like a cliff.
Texts.artifactSet.dawn.description: The first ray of light, and the first thrust of the spear.
Texts.artifactSet.ember.description: The heat of the first smith in every arrow.
Texts.artifactSet.frost.description: A winter that chose to stay. Keeps the hero on their feet.
Texts.artifactSet.amber.description: Resin preserves everything, even those who swore an oath.
Texts.artifactSet.tide.description: The sea returns twice a day, and so do skills.
Texts.artifactSet.horn.description: A horn that calls the infantry forward and keeps it from falling.
Texts.artifactSet.thorn.description: A grove that decides for itself whom to let go. It stands, and it wounds.
Texts.artifactSet.ash.description: Here the ash rises from below, like those who wear it.
Texts.artifactSet.moon.description: At night you can see a hundred paces. The archer sees first.
Texts.artifactSet.obsidian.description: Glass that remembers fire. The last wall.
Texts.artifactSet.zenith.description: At noon there are no shadows, and nowhere to hide from the spears.
Texts.artifactSet.gale.description: The wind sweeps everything off the trail, except those who side with it.
Texts.dungeon.sunken_crypt.description: The water took the city, but not those who guarded it.
Texts.dungeon.ember_forge.description: A hearth that has not gone out since the days of the first smith.
Texts.dungeon.flint_mines.description: Stone for the first axes was quarried here, and not everyone made it out.
Texts.dungeon.frozen_hold.description: Winter moved inside and chose to stay.
Texts.dungeon.tidal_caves.description: Twice a day the sea takes these tunnels back.
Texts.dungeon.amber_shore.description: The resin holds those who once fell asleep here.
Texts.dungeon.storm_spire.description: Lightning strikes it so often that the stone rings.
Texts.dungeon.thorn_grove.description: A grove that decides for itself whom to let go.
Texts.dungeon.horn_valley.description: Horns sounded the call to battle here for so long that the echo stayed.
Texts.dungeon.ash_barrows.description: Here the ash falls from above and rises from below.
Texts.dungeon.hollow_deep.description: A place where sound ends before the corridor does.
Texts.dungeon.moon_marsh.description: At night you can see a hundred paces here, and you can be seen just as far.
Texts.dungeon.gale_pass.description: The wind sweeps everything off the trail, except the wardens.
Texts.dungeon.obsidian_vault.description: Glass that remembers the fire it was born from.
Texts.dungeon.zenith_cathedral.description: At noon the shadows here vanish, and with them every place to hide.
